description: Sets words by the index get_transcript gave them, keeping their timing; empty text removes a word, and count joins that many words into one spanning them all (two words heard for one). Then save_video writes the video again.

count.description: How many words from index the text replaces, as one word (default 1)

project_id.description: The project id a caption_video call returned (on this computer, a file's path)

name: fix_words
